title: The Soviet officer who personally prevented WWIII
voiceover: In nineteen eighty-three, one Soviet officer single-handedly prevented World War Three. His name was Stanislav Petrov. He was on duty at a Russian early warning bunker when the alarms went off. The system reported five American nuclear missiles inbound. Protocol said: report it immediately. Soviet doctrine said: launch everything in retaliation. Petrov had minutes. He called it a false alarm. He was right. A satellite glitch had mistaken sunlight for missiles. If he had followed protocol, hundreds of millions of people would have died that day. He told no one for over a decade. He died in twenty seventeen, mostly unknown. Follow for one mind-blowing fact a day.
